observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same black projector from slightly different angles.
The brand 'vivitek' is clearly visible in white text on the front panel in both photos.
Above the brand name, there is Chinese text: '臺北縣政府' (Taipei County Government).
The front panel has a control pad with buttons labeled: POWER, TEMP, MENU, AUTO, SOURCE, and directional arrows with an enter button.
A lens with a focus ring is visible on the left side of the front panel.
The surface of the projector is glossy and shows reflections and smudges.
There is a watermark 'PROJECTOR CENTER POSTED ON JIJI' on both photos.
No model number is visible on the front or side in either photo.
The projector appears to be placed on a tiled surface in photo 0 and on a brown fabric surface in photo 1.

claims.claim: The vivitek d825mx projector is a xga conference room projector.
claims.evidence: The model name 'd825mx' and 'XGA' resolution are not visible in the photos. The brand 'vivitek' is confirmed, but the model and specifications are not readable.
There is no visible lamp or lamp compartment in the photos. The type of light source (lamp vs. LED/Laser) cannot be determined from the exterior.

risks.risk: The projector may not be the claimed model 'd825mx' or may not be XGA resolution.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label, usually on the bottom or back of the projector, or a screenshot of the on-screen menu showing model and resolution.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Vivitek projector without model-specific value, which may be significantly lower than a D825MX.

risks.risk: The projector may be non-functional or have a dead lamp.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the projector powered on, projecting an image, and the lamp indicator light functioning.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

risks.risk: The projector may have internal damage or wear not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the interior, including the lens, lamp housing, and cooling system, or a demonstration of focus and image quality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential internal issues, assuming worst-case condition.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom or back of the projector showing the model number label.
Video clip of the projector turned on and projecting an image.
Photo of the lamp compartment or lamp itself, if accessible.
Photo of the projector's on-screen menu showing model and resolution.
response.reason: The model and key specifications (XGA, D825MX) are not visible in the photos, and the lamp type and functionality cannot be confirmed. Without proof of model and working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk of being misidentified or non-functional.
